messages:
alyssa: Draft ready — TL;DR: Dedicated + Hosted options, cost/perf benchmarks, CTA to register for demo. Need quick content + legal pass by EOD so we can schedule publish and the webinar capture.
omar: Sending a few nits. Can we tighten the benchmark paragraph? Suggest moving latency numbers into a bullet list.
marta: Quick legal flag: can't use the phrase "industry-leading" without backup. Can you add source citations or swap to "industry-proven"?
alyssa: Good catch Marta — will replace with "production-grade" and add a footnote to our benchmark doc. Is that ok?
marta: That works. Also, don't promise uptime SLAs in the post — leave just "SLA-backed options".
kevin: For CTAs, two variants — one for demo signups (webinar) and one for trial signups (hosted). Recommend using dedicated UTMs: utm_campaign=prod_launch_3.1
lina: HubSpot mapping: please add the webinar form id 5f3a2 to the demo CTA. Also need to tag leads with "launch_webinar_031" for routing.
alyssa: Adding form id. Draft CTAs:
```
Join the live demo — reserve your spot
Start a free trial of Redwood Inference
```
Thoughts on primary CTA?
omar: Primary CTA should be demo signups. We want to capture product-intent leads first.
kevin: Agree. Also, can we add a microcopy hint under the CTA — "limited seats" — to reduce no-shows?
alyssa: Good idea. I'll add: "Limited seats — register now to save your spot." 
marta: Also confirm data handling for registrants — are we sharing PII with any partner? If yes, we need DPA clause link.
lina: No partner sharing. Add consent copy: "By registering, you agree to receive product updates from Redwood." We'll include link to privacy policy.
alyssa: Updated live draft: replaced claims, added footnote to benchmarks, adjusted CTAs and microcopy, HubSpot form id added, UTM updated.
kevin: Can someone do a quick editorial pass? Just grammar + two headline variants A/B.
omar: I'll take headlines: 1) "Ship fast, serve reliably: Redwood Inference 3.1" 2) "Lower LLM costs without sacrificing latency"
alyssa: Love 1 for hero. Kevin, assign to design for hero image and demo CTA placement.
kevin: @design-squad assigned — please deliver hero by tomorrow noon.
publish-bot: Reminder: staging publish slot reserved for 03/29 09:00 UTC if content + assets are ready by 03/28 18:00 UTC.
alyssa: OK team — final asks: Marta signoff by EOD, Design deliver hero by noon tomorrow, Kevin confirm HubSpot routing, Omar finalize headline. If all ✅ I'll schedule with publish-bot.
marta: Quick ✅ from legal on the current wording. one tiny tweak to footnote language sent in DM. :thumbsup: 
kevin: HubSpot routing confirmed — forms & tags set.
omar: Headline locked.
alyssa: Scheduling now.
publish-bot: Scheduled to staging: 3412349000. Notify #marketing when promoted to prod.
kevin: :tada: Great work — will prep demo ops to capture registrants.
alyssa: Thanks everyone — will post final links in this thread once live.
